Tut.1_Desc: Velkommen til RagnaController! Denne tutorial vil hjælpe dig i gang.
Tut_1_Desc: Before you start, make sure to select your Ragnarok Online executable in the settings. The 'Focus Lock' feature ensures your controller only works when the game window is active, protecting you from accidental clicks in Windows.
Tut_2_Desc: Tired of missing tiny items? When you open your inventory, use the D-Krydspad to snap the cursor perfectly from slot to slot. Tryk 'A' to double-click and equip items instantly.
Tut_3_Desc: At kaste Storm Gust har aldrig været nemmere. Hold din færdighed knap (fx L1 + A). Der kommer en målgruppe. Sigt med den rette pind. Du skal blot flytte knappen for at kaste besværgelsen!
Tut_4_Desc: Having trouble clicking on a fast-moving Poring? Just tilt the Højre Stik slightly towards the monster and click R3. The engine will fire a micro-spiral click, guaranteeing a hit on the hitbox.
Tut_5_Desc: Need complex combos? Optag your key presses, then open the Visual Timeline Redigeror. You can drag and drop the delays perfectly to match the server's lag and your character's ASPD.
